wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 11-003 aggregates the S_AdjustSoundParams distance/pan/volume computation (adjustSoundParams) and the per-tic S_UpdateSounds listener/origin re-evaluation (updateSounds, buildChannelUpdateStates) into a single src/vanilla re-export facade for the audio ticker. The read-only src/audio/spatial.ts and soundOrigins.ts already implement vanilla s_sound.c semantics (P_AproxDistance attenuation, R_PointToAngle2 stereo pan, MAP08 boss-floor branch); pure barrel + frozen manifest, no source modification.
